# Read This Part First

This part of the book guides you step by step from installing Python through launching your first ADK agent. Each chapter answers three questions:

1. **What outcome are you targeting?**
2. **What do you need before you begin?**
3. **How do you check that it worked?**

> [!goal]
> Understand the path ahead, know which operating system chapter to follow, and be ready to create a clean Python workspace.

## Structure of the Setup Part

- **Preparation** — key terms and why the guide standardises on Python 3.11.
- **Python Installation** — choose either macOS or Windows instructions.
- **Virtual Environment and `pip`** — how to keep your ADK tools isolated.
- **Install ADK** — add the Google toolkit inside your environment.
- **First Agent** — scaffold a project and open the local web UI.
- **Jupyter (Optional)** — integrate notebooks when useful.

> [!tip]
> When you reach an operating system branch, complete only the chapter that matches your computer. Return to the shared chapters once that installation succeeds.

## Checkpoints

Each chapter ends with a `[!check]` callout describing what success looks like. If a step fails, jump to the Troubleshooting part—every symptom has a matching fix.
